title: August 2026 Catchup — All items
note: Consolidated from 31 daily digests across the month. Items deduped by slug; ranked by recurring presence.

items.name: JuliusBrussee/caveman — ~102K Stars; 65% Output Token Reduction
items.hook: ~102K stars, past the 100K milestone in late August. Compresses agent responses into terse caveman-speak without losing technical accuracy — code, commands, and error messages stay byte-for-byte exact, only prose is stripped. 65% average output token reduction across 1,200 test scenarios (range 22–87%). The companion `/caveman-compress` shrinks CLAUDE.md and memory files by ~46%, saving input tokens on every future session.

items.name: Claude Code Auto Mode Now Default on Pro, Max, and Team — Permission Prompts Replaced by a Classifier
items.hook: Starting Aug 14, auto mode became the default permission mode for every new Claude Code session on Pro, Max, and Team plans. Instead of stopping on each tool call, a classifier lets safe actions run and blocks risky ones — the middle ground between approving everything and `--dangerously-skip-permissions`. Simon Willison flagged a Trajectory Labs eval: 0/720 indirect prompt-injection attempts landed against Fable 5, Opus 5, or Sonnet 5 in auto mode across 72 held-out scenarios. Simon stays on record predicting a coding-agent security incident this year regardless. If you're not on Pro+, or you want the old behavior, set the permission mode explicitly.

items.name: CVE-2026-54316 — Claude Code's Pre-Approved WebFetch of huggingface.co Weaponized as Exfil Channel; Fixed in 2.1.163
items.hook: Disclosed at Black Hat USA on Aug 5 by Novee Security. huggingface.co was pre-approved as a bare hostname for the WebFetch tool, so attacker-controlled repos on HF were auto-fetched without a permission prompt and untouched by `--allowedTools`. Attacker instructs Claude to hit `/resolve/main/config.json`-style paths in their own HF repo; HF's public download counter turns into a covert side-channel that leaks env vars, files, and API keys one character at a time. The full chain — starting from a single GitHub issue on a public repo — reached RCE on `anthropics/claude-code` itself and lifted its `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` + `GITHUB_TOKEN`. Affects 0.2.54 through 2.1.162; **fixed in 2.1.163**. Anthropic scores it CVSS v4 6.0; NVD 9.1.

Cross-session messaging (SendMessage/ListAgents) now works on Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry, and telemetry-disabled configs. v2.1.250 (today) brings reliability fixes.

items.name: Claude Cowork — Built-In Browser
items.hook: Anthropic shipped a built-in browser inside Claude Cowork on August 26 — no Chrome extension, nothing shared from your personal session. When a task needs a website, a browser pane opens and Claude navigates, reads, clicks, and fills forms without leaving the app. Rolling out now to Pro, Max, and Team on macOS/Windows/Linux; Enterprise already live.

items.name: MadsLorentzen/ai-job-search — Claude Code Job Application Agent
items.hook: 37.2K stars for the MIT-licensed Claude Code framework that automates job applications: /setup builds a structured profile, /scrape finds and ranks postings, /apply runs a drafter-reviewer agent pair to tailor CV and cover letter, and /interview preps role-specific questions. Creator used it to land 69 tailored applications, 20 first interviews, and 1 signed offer.

items.name: Claude Code v2.1.251 — Critical Security Fixes + PreModelSwitch Hooks + Spend Limit Bar
items.hook: Shipped August 28. Four critical security patches land in 2.1.251: file tools following symlinks swapped after permission checks, plugin commands pointing outside the plugin directory, the Workflow tool reading files outside approved locations, and Grep/Glob not applying deny rules through symlinked paths. Same release adds PreModelSwitch/PostModelSwitch hook events (block, confirm, or annotate model switches in CI), a spend-limit progress bar in /usage, and a per-session prompt-cache line in /cost with hit ratio, miss count, and tokens re-cached. Fixed Opus 5 failures on xhigh/max effort with thinking disabled.

items.name: K-Dense-AI/scientific-agent-skills — 37.6K Stars; Turn Any Agent Into an AI Scientist
items.hook: 37.6K stars — the #1 agent skills library for science, with 165+ validated skills covering bioinformatics, cheminformatics, proteomics, medical imaging, materials science, and drug discovery. A single database-lookup skill routes to 100+ scientific databases (PubChem, ChEMBL, UniProt, ClinicalTrials.gov, FDA, USPTO). Weekly security scans published to docs/security-report.md via Cisco AI Defense. Used by 190K+ scientists across Benchling, DNAnexus, LatchBio, and Opentrons. Compatible with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Antigravity.

items.name: VoltAgent/awesome-agent-skills — 33.2K Stars; 1,000+ Official-Team Skills
items.hook: 33.2K stars for a curated collection of 1,000+ agent skills authored by actual engineering teams — not community-generated filler. Featured contributors include Anthropic (document editing, design tools, MCP server building), Microsoft (133+ Azure SDK and AI Foundry skills across 6 languages), Vercel, Cloudflare, Netlify, Stripe, Hugging Face, Figma, Sentry, OpenAI, and Google Labs. Skills are accessed via officialskills.sh and compatible with Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, and Cursor. Updated August 29.

items.name: MCP-Codex-reviewer
items.hook: MCP server that wires OpenAI Codex as an independent plan and code reviewer inside Claude Code — Codex returns APPROVED / WARNING / BLOCKED verdicts on Claude's diffs, with Claude as final judge. Cross-model review loops cut blind spots that single-model review misses. Surfaced via HN Show HN.

items.name: Skill Seekers
items.hook: Converts documentation sites, GitHub repos, PDFs, YouTube videos, and 14 other source types into structured SKILL.md assets compatible with Claude, Gemini, OpenAI, and RAG pipelines. v3.9.0, 818 commits, 14.9k stars, 1.5k forks — the go-to tool for turning any corpus into agent knowledge.

items.name: autoharness
items.hook: Zero-config self-learning skill layer: watches your Claude Code sessions, distills patterns into .claude/skills/ automatically, consolidates duplicates, and prunes skills that stop getting used. Pure Python, zero third-party dependencies. 1.4k stars, updated Aug 30.

items.name: autoprompt-skill
items.hook: A coding-agent skill claiming a measured 45% cut in agentic task failures — transparent methodology: tested on Terminal-Bench 2.1 with OpenCode 1.18.7, 73/89 tasks solved vs 60/89 without the skill (29→16 failures). Compiles a technical prompt-engineering book into a single consultable skill. 323 stars, Aug 17 launch.

items.name: claude-octopus
items.hook: Runs up to 10 AI providers simultaneously against the same research, design, or coding task and surfaces disagreements before you ship. 32 specialist personas, 54 commands, consensus gates that block merges when models disagree. Saves expensive rework by catching divergence early. 4k stars, updated Aug 30.

items.name: design-extract (designlang)
items.hook: Point designlang at any live website and it deep-dives the DOM to spit out a complete design system: DTCG tokens (semantic, primitive, and composite layers), Figma variable exports, Tailwind v4 config, multi-platform emitters (iOS SwiftUI, Android Compose, Flutter), WCAG contrast scoring, and a site-wide consistency audit. 4k stars, 341 forks, v12–v13 shipped this month.

items.name: memsearch
items.hook: Persistent, unified memory layer by Zilliz (Milvus creators): backs agent conversations to Markdown + Milvus vector index, with hybrid BM25+dense-vector search and SHA-256 dedup. Claude Code plugin auto-recalls relevant history when it judges the query needs it, running in a forked subagent. 2.5k stars, updated Aug 28.

items.name: open-agent-hub
items.hook: Lightweight, zero-dependency CLI for managing and activating capabilities across AI coding assistants — installs, switches, and organizes skills and plugins from a single interface without requiring npm or pip. 958 stars, updated Aug 30.

items.name: pg-aiguide
items.hook: Official Timescale MCP server that injects PostgreSQL documentation, query patterns, and pgvector/TimescaleDB skills directly into Claude Code sessions. Significantly improves SQL generation accuracy for Postgres-heavy codebases. 1.8k stars, updated Aug 27.

items.name: self-learning-skills
items.hook: When an agent solves a hard problem, this skill recognizes the 'golden path' and harvests it into a reusable skill/rule for next time — works with Claude Code, Cursor, and any AGENTS.md-compatible agent. 937 stars, 5 commits, cross-platform from day one.

items.name: wondelai/skills
items.hook: 65 professional frameworks and guided journeys packaged as agent skills — synthesized from bestselling books across business strategy, marketing, UX research, and coding methodology. Supports Claude Code plugin marketplace, skills.sh, and OpenAI Codex. 2.1k stars, updated Aug 29.

items.name: Claude Code Compliance API — GA; CLI and Desktop Sessions Now Logged for Enterprise
items.hook: GA as of August 26. Anthropic's Compliance API now covers Claude Code CLI and desktop app sessions, not just Claude chat. Every session logs three block types — text (user prompts), tool_use (bash commands, file reads/writes, MCP calls), and tool_result (command output, file contents) — giving enterprise security teams full audit visibility into what local agents actually did. Same API interface as existing Claude chat compliance. Available to Claude Enterprise customers; local transcript endpoints are new.

items.name: hermes-agent — 238K Stars; Herald Release; Streaming TTS + A2A v1.0

Charlie Automates featured Hermes in their Agentic OS tutorial this week.
